text:
Lukas Meyer: hey all started today on product analytics. quick q: my laptop arrived but the VPN cert prompt never showed. also, curious where the team keeps the standing desk + chair signup? fun fact: i collect 35mm cameras and may bring one for the office wall display.

Aisha Rahman: welcome @Lukas! re: chairs/desks there's a google sheet pinned in #people-ops with the office gear signup. For VPN certs try: System Preferences gt; Profiles gt; look for "Redwood VPN" and accept. If nothing, open Keychain Access -> Certificates and check for redwood-root cert.

IT Support Bot: ticket created: IT-8123. Please confirm the laptop serial and OS version. Temporary access: use the cloud jumpbox if you need to access internal services.

Lukas Meyer: serial DQXW12345Z, macOS 14.2. I tried the profiles step and no VPN profile present. Keychain shows no redwood-root cert either.

Tom Hayes: @Lukas adding you to the product-analytics onboarding call at 4pm and the quick desk tour at 2pm. For immediate work, here's a devenv in the cloud: ssh lukas@jumpbox-prod.redwood.ai (creds in 1Password). Re: camera display, yes please we have a tiny gallery wall near the kitchen.

IT Support Bot: thanks IT escalated to network team; ETA 45m. In the meantime, run this so we can capture the VPN installer logs:

```
sudo cat /var/log/vpninstall.log | tail -n 50 > /tmp/vpnlog.txt
# upload to ticket IT-8123 using the web portal
```

People Ops Bot: welcome Lukas! Lunch invite sent for Friday new-hires meet-and-greet. Also fill out the "workstation preferences" form linked in the DM so we can reserve a chair.

Lukas Meyer: thanks everyone I uploaded the vpnlog and filled the form. excited to be here and looking forward to meeting the camera-curious crew.
